review.notes: Full review. The gate, rerun at this head, fails on sorry-data=6, dropped=38 (SurfaceTopology/PlanarTopology, both never-cite), blob=8 and statement-hygiene=4. Depcheck: 239 roadmaps, 2354 edges, 0 problems; it cannot see SurfaceTopology/PlanarTopology because they are not in the order. Suggested.lean elaborates (exit 0, 24 sorry warnings). A scratch probe confirms about 40 Mathlib and Tau Ceti declarations that duplicate this file's objects. They include the PSL/PGL actions, cusp data, CompactifiedQuotient with compactness for cofinite groups, TauCeti.eulerChar, the branched-cover Euler formula and the 1/42 deficit bound. The pi/21 and pi/3 headlines elaborate on native carriers but are not stated. A tested repair puts genus on TauCeti.eulerChar and keeps all 11 checks of main's ModularForms consumer working. Of the previous review's 14 findings, R02, R04 and R12 are repaired and R14 is moot; the rest are partly or not repaired. Seeded sample: all 7 Source spines are textbooks with no legal copy (sources service: no legal source or paywalled), as is Siegel 1945; recorded as not verifiable. The adversarial table has 20 rows of computed values. Ownership against KleinianGroups was not checked (files not provided).
